prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "Your pet lives directly on your desktop screen! Learn the basic controls before you start.", "Got It!", "Right-click your pet to open quick interactions, or check your system tray menu to hide or adjust pet settings."]
2: ["Did you know? You can feed and play with your pet directly on your desktop taskbar."]
3: ["Welcome Your Companion Home", "Your companion will be bound to your signed-in account so your pet's state and memory are safely preserved across sessions.", "I'm Ready"]
4: ["Choose Your Perfect Companion", "Select your starter companion"]
5: ["Signing in ensures your pet's personality and progress stay saved safely to your account."]
6: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet"]
7: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "If your pet does not appear immediately on screen, check your system tray menu icon or grant desktop overlay permission.", "Tip: You can re-center your pet anytime from the system tray menu."]
8: ["Setup takes only 2 minutes!", "Hi there! Pick a path to start adopting your new desktop friend."]
9: ["For best results, upload high-resolution, well-lit photos facing forward.", "Clear photos produce the most accurate custom desktop companion!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user.
